item.title: CSS-Tricks has a new owner
item.description: Yes, I've got the keys to the castle, so to speak. And, even after 12 years of working on the site, I'll admit I'm a little overwhelmed and nervous about that. (3 sources: hackernews, javascriptweekly, lobsters)

item.title: Chrome Opens Trial for the Email Verification API: Letting Sites Verify Without Sending Emails
item.description: Google has opened a Chrome origin trial for the Email Verification API, a WICG proposal that lets the browser confirm email ownership without sending a message. Gmail is the first provider. (1 source: infoq)
